method: Actual source-image and authored render pixel comparison; photos were not used as textures. This is a photo-fit exterior comparison, not an as-built or measured-fidelity certification.
sources_inspected: S02 university S1 and interior roof photograph
S07 physical page 82 aerial already reused by S06 page 64
U01 physical page 44 native parking photographs

visual_iterations.issue: Initial low wing too short relative to bare-roof outline
visual_iterations.change: Fitted low-wing depth from 55 to 80 normalized mm against hall depth 140; kept a real joined volume.

visual_iterations.issue: Cap breadth and glazed opening articulation
visual_iterations.change: Narrowed raised cap from 16 to 13 mm against 81 mm roof width; preserved broad roof. Flattened glazed fanlights and added transoms while leaving real track arcade voids.
Changed two broad placeholder groups to four narrower rectangular groups, with low wall/window zone retained.
Placed tall strips on the two evidenced long faces; removed an early erroneous strip on the southwest end wall. End remains largely solid with sparse windows.
Moved ramp to track-side -X, corresponding to viewer-right in front source photographs; did not mirror a second ramp.
Set rooflight side-glass body below the cap top, with a small overlap under the pale cap; eliminated material seam artefacts without changing the narrow cap envelope.

final_observations: Whole low/high complex, external stair, open portico and stepped low-wing roofs visible.
Main roof is broad, with a separately legible narrow raised longitudinal curved cap.
Track lower arch bays are real voids with set-back backing; road lower arches are glazed windows, not mirror copies.
Two thin open roadside roofs, slender posts, open central aisle and low hall window band remain visible.
Southwest end is mostly solid; tall corner strips are confined to long faces.
No source pixels, PV, neighboring buildings, scooters, payment gates or invented small devices are present.
remaining_limits: All scales, heights, curvature and spacing remain normalized photo-fit estimates.
Fine equipment, lettering and railings are omitted or simplified; no unobserved interior/grade/foundation claim.
Print thickening and support requirements are documented separately.
